pipeline.title: AbbVie scratches out phase 3 hidradenitis suppurativa win but falls short of expectations
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 trial of AbbVie’s lutikizumab in hidradenitis suppurativa has hit its primary endpoint. But with the drug candidate beating placebo by a narrower margin than expected, the readout raises questions about AbbVie’s chances of cracking a competitive market.

pipeline.title: Roivant comes for Humira as Lisraya checks boxes in inflammatory eye disease phase 3s
pipeline.summary: With the ink barely dry on Lisraya’s first approval, Roivant and its spinout Priovant are wasting little time in making the case for the dual TYK2/JAK1 inhibitor to claim a larger immune-mediated kingdom.

pipeline.title: Roche builds blockbuster BTK case for fenebrutinib in multiple sclerosis as FDA decision approaches
pipeline.summary: Roche has dived into the data behind its filing for FDA approval of fenebrutinib in multiple sclerosis, unpacking the BTK inhibitor’s effect on chronic active lesions, disease control and brain volume.

pipeline.title: Cosette lands FDA approval for Evoxac liquid in Sjögren’s disease
pipeline.summary: The approval is for a liquid formulation of Evoxac, which was originally marketed by Daiichi Sankyo in capsules, providing an alternative treatment option for managing dry mouth symptoms in patients living with Sjögren’s disease.

pipeline.title: Advocacy organization launches data dashboard to better assess how clinical trial sites perform
pipeline.summary: The Society for Clinical Research Sites (SCRS) has launched a data intelligence platform to offer fresh insights into how different locations compare.

pipeline.title: Rapport's phase 2 bipolar win strikes chord with analysts despite falling short of original ambition
pipeline.summary: Rapport Therapeutics’ phase 2 bipolar mania study has hit its primary endpoint, furthering the biotech’s efforts to make RAP-219 a multiindication blockbuster. However, the effect size fell short of the level targeted by Rapport and analysts ahead of the readout.

pipeline.title: Veradermics' hot streak continues with another phase 3 win in hair loss
pipeline.summary: Topline results show the biotech's lead asset, VDPHL01, cleared all primary and secondary endpoints in a study of more than 500 men with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss.

pipeline.title: Pfizer makes ‘business decision’ to end phase 2 trial of autoimmune drug as program’s future uncertain
pipeline.summary: Pfizer has called time on a phase 2 trial of its CXCR5 antibody in an autoimmune blood disorder, with the company tight-lipped on whether this marks the end of the road for the asset.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca taps Oracle to help improve recruitment for clinical trials
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca has turned to data giant Oracle as the U.K.-based Big Pharma works on one of the eternal problems of drug development—improving patient recruitment.

pipeline.title: Amgen, AZ dive deep into Tezspire's Dupixent-challenging victory in EoE phase 3
pipeline.summary: With little time elapsed since AstraZeneca and Amgen unveiled a topline win for Tezspire over the summer, the partners are upping the stakes with a detailed look at their inflammation-fighting antibody’s prowess in eosinophilic esophagitis.

pipeline.title: Israeli biotech’s inhaled exosome therapy reduces respiratory failure in phase 2 study
pipeline.summary: Nano24’s inhaled exosome therapy reduced respiratory failure in patients with acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), hitting the main goal of a phase 2b study.

pipeline.title: GSK’s Jemperli scores FDA approval in rectal cancer, backed by high complete response rate
pipeline.summary: Building on the buzz around a celebrated early trial readout, GSK’s Jemperli has earned a first-in-class FDA approval in a specific type of rectal cancer.

pipeline.title: Moderna, Merck shares fall on eagerly anticipated cancer vaccine results
pipeline.summary: A combination of the shot and the immunotherapy Keytruda cut the risk of relapse or death by 42% in a landmark melanoma study that met Wall Street expectations but triggered a “sell-the-news reaction,” one analyst wrote.

pipeline.title: Biohaven’s previously rejected rare disease drug to get fresh FDA review
pipeline.summary: U.S. regulators have accepted a new submission for Vyglxia, offering the chance at a turnaround for another rare disease medicine spurned by previous FDA leadership.

pipeline.title: GLP-1 compounder issues recall for copycat Zepbound
pipeline.summary: The notice adds to growing concerns about the safety of knockoff weight loss drugs, which have remained popular despite FDA warnings and legal pressure from Eli Lilly and Novo.

pipeline.title: Roche affirms sales outlook amid doubts about its future
pipeline.summary: Lower-than-expected sales of Xolair stood out as the Swiss drugmaker readies for an onslaught of generic competition for top products.

pipeline.title: AZ's Ultomiris adds 5th rare disease feather to cap with FDA IgAN nod
pipeline.summary: With a late Thursday nod from the FDA to reduce protein levels in the urine of patients with primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN), AstraZeneca’s Alexion-born Ultomiris has racked up its fifth rare disease indication in the United States.

pipeline.title: Celltrion picks up another Kaigene autoimmune antibody for up to $580.5M
pipeline.summary: Celltrion has licensed a preclinical antibody targeting autoimmune conditions from Maryland-based biotech Kaigene in a deal worth up to $580.5 million, marking another step in the South Korean drugmaker's expansion beyond its traditional biosimilar business.

pipeline.title: Esteve earmarks $80M to revamp CDMO operations in China
pipeline.summary: In the next phase of its global expansion, Esteve is set to invest $80 million in an upgrade and relocation of its CDMO business in China.

pipeline.title: Vabysmo shows signs of reacceleration as Roche gears up for busy 2027
pipeline.summary: After disappointing Wall Street for most of 2026, Roche’s eye disease drug Vabysmo met analysts’ expectations for the first time this year. But the company may have bigger fish to fry heading into 2027.

pipeline.title: Menarini's Stemline picks up Georgiamune preclinical cancer immunotherapy in $1.1B deal
pipeline.summary: Georgiamune, an immunology-focused biotech out of Maryland, has licensed a preclinical cancer drug candidate to Stemline Therapeutics, owned by Italy's Menarini Group, for up to $1.1 billion.

pipeline.title: Pfizer's latest cost-savings plan looks to get early start as layoff reports surface around Europe, US plants
pipeline.summary: Local news reported Pfizer layoffs in Michigan and North Carolina as the drugmaker kicks off $2.5 billion in planned cost cuts. Pfizer declined to comment on the total number of jobs affected or when the layoffs would go into effect.

pipeline.title: Quest Diagnostics’ test results system breached in yet another medtech cyberattack
pipeline.summary: Quest Diagnostics is the latest life sciences company to fall victim to a cyberattack, with the company believing patient records have been compromised.

pipeline.title: FDA rebukes Baxter over 'repeated' production stumbles in new warning letter
pipeline.summary: The FDA rebuked Baxter in a lengthy warning letter that outlined a series of production violations that led to a trio of recalls earlier this year.

pipeline.title: AbbVie pumps up the economic case for early subcutaneous Parkinson’s treatment
pipeline.summary: Delaying the use of subcutaneous Parkinson’s disease treatments by one year increases annual medical costs by 59.1%, AbbVie-sponsored research found.

pipeline.title: Rebranded NodThera plans IPO to fund NLRP3 inhibitor’s push toward approval
pipeline.summary: NodThera—under its new name Rezera—is planning an IPO as the biotech steps up its ambitions to get its NLRP3 inhibitor to market.

pipeline.title: Roche’s CEO has ‘absolutely not’ changed tune on Poseida despite scrapping CAR-T from the buyout
pipeline.summary: Roche’s CEO has insisted to Fierce that the company’s view on its $1.5 billion Poseida buyout has “absolutely not” changed, even as the Swiss pharma scraps one of the CAR-T therapy’s from the acquisition.

pipeline.title: Abbott to separate Nutrition business into an independent, publicly traded company
pipeline.summary: Abbott will separate its Nutrition business into an independent, publicly traded company through a tax-free distribution to Abbott shareholders.

pipeline.title: Otsuka hit with 11 marketing code breaches after event organizer blunder
pipeline.summary: The PMCPA has ruled that Otsuka Europe’s involvement with a sponsored symposium webpage breached 11 clauses of the U.K. marketing code. While the PMCPA found fault with many aspects of the webpage, the watchdog opted against hitting Otsuka with its toughest punishment.

pipeline.title: GSK, Ionis win US approval for first-of-its-kind hepatitis B drug
pipeline.summary: Hibsago is viewed as a potential “functional cure” for chronic infections and an important part of the British drugmaker’s goal of reaching £40 billion in annual revenue by 2031.

pipeline.title: Roivant, continuing ascent, claims another victory for rare disease drug
